Title: Azure Spring Cloud Basic tier is now in preview

Body.Content:
Azure Spring Cloud Basic tier is now available in preview. Use the new Basic tier to get started with Spring Cloud development and testing at a lower cost, and then switch to the Standard tier when ready for production.

Learn more
